description: Scoped SkyeVault custody folders for source, agents, blog surfaces, and client build lanes that should be protected before or alongside Git.

export.purpose: Autosync runs the normal repo/source-custody lane, then writes companion bin exports for agent/site lanes with file-level dedupe between bins.

securityRules: Bins are encrypted before vault storage.
Agents may read bin manifests and receipts, but must not print secrets, passphrases, bearer tokens, admin codes, raw env values, or private unlock material.
Public pages may reference receipt IDs and gated proof routes, not private handoff files.
Import/export/deploy-from-vault remains beta until stress proof and owner approval are recorded.

bins.label: ☣️ DevodeRator Blog Bin
bins.purpose: Founder daily blog, copied social assets, business-card mirrors, DevodeRator agent instructions, and proof-linked writing surfaces.

bins.label: SkyeAgents Bin
bins.purpose: Agent cards, site rules, operator prompts, and AI-readable workflow instructions that should be preserved without leaking credentials.

bins.label: Client Portal Builds Bin
bins.purpose: Client portal/build imports, SupaBoy-style build lanes, and generated proof receipts that may be too large or too temporary for Git-first handling.

bins.label: Founder Song Vault Bin
bins.purpose: Browser-downloadable Founder Command song copies, original master references, generated-song manifest, and the repeatable builder that rebuilds the vault.
